# Agent Skills packages

This folder contains the installable Agent Skills version of the Procurement AI Assistant.

Each skill is a standalone folder containing `SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter and an MIT licence file. The folders follow the Agent Skills open format.

For non-technical installation, use the ready-made ZIP files in [`../packages`](../packages).

Important: upload the **individual skill ZIP** you want to install. `procurement-ai-assistant-all-skill-zips.zip` is only a convenience bundle containing all individual installer ZIPs; it is not itself one skill.
